subject: Interim CSM assignment for Acme — transfer & customer notice

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: interim CSM for Acme (manager notice)

Team —

Quick context: Diego (Acme CSM) informed me this morning heneeds to step away for a personal leave starting 6/21 for an expected ~8 weeks. Hewill remain on support for his open high-priority items through next Friday, but we need an interim assignment and a short transfer plan before he leaves.

As this is a strategic account (Acme, ARR ~ $1.2M), I want to:
- Assign an interim CSM who can own day-to-day and the upcoming renewal prep
- Share a brief customer-facing note announcing the interim lead (coached handoff)
- Complete the internal transfer paperwork and a short performance summary for continuity

Proposed interim: Marissa Cole for client-facing ownership starting 6/22, with Ben as escalation owner for exec outreach if needed. Marissa has worked the account previously on integrations and knows the renewal history.

Can we fast-track approval + a signed transfer form by EOD Tuesday? Mina, can People Ops confirm any paperwork or approval we need for this short-term reassignment (comp changes, expense approvals, or credit allowances)?

Idrafted a one-paragraph customer note below for review before I send to Sarah (Acme):
"Hi Sarah — Diego will be taking a temporary leave starting 6/21. Marissa Cole will step in as your interim CSM while heis out. Marissa and I will be available for anything urgent; Diego will remain looped for handover items. We expect continuity of support and will share a short plan for the next 8 weeks.

Please confirm if youwant to set a quick 30-min intro with Marissa this week. — Olga"

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Customer Success

2) For any commercial concessions tied to the leave (discounts, credits), loop Finance and get Mina to confirm approvals. If a retention credit is requested, Iprefer we structure as a one-time service credit rather than changing contract pricing.

If Marissa can take an intro with Sarah this Thursday (6/17) at 10am PT, I will join.

- I attached a draft transfer form ("transfer_form_signed_draft.pdf"). Please review and sign; I will countersign and upload to the employee record.

- Effective interim start date: 2026-06-22
- Expected duration: 8 weeks (estimated)
- Primary responsibilities: day-to-day account management; escalation to Ben for executive-level outreach

I will also add a brief note to Diegoemployee file indicating this is a temporary reassignment for personal leave.
